title: xingo-statla: updatable and matrix-free linear algebra for statistics
description:
Updatable and matrix-free linear algebra for statistics in pure Rust: a thin QR with explicit Q and a Cholesky factor updated in place when rows, columns or rank-1 terms arrive or leave, with transactional failures; the randomized SVD of Halko, Martinsson and Tropp with a reproducible generator; a truncated SVD by thick-restart Golub–Kahan–Lanczos bidiagonalization; and ARPACK-style eigsh/eigs by Krylov–Schur restarted Lanczos/Arnoldi, with shift-invert over sparse factorizations and an inertia count. Generic in the scalar type, over a linear-operator trait. Part of the Xingó project.
